name: Hotel Tsepal Yangjom Restaurant
why_it_matters: Three-star hotel restaurant on Bomdila's main bazar line — multi-cuisine kitchen with an in-house chef who switches between Indian, Chinese, and Monpa local dishes. Default sit-down dining for tour groups passing Bomdila on the Tezpur-Tawang corridor.
insider_tip: Ask whether yak is on the menu before ordering — supply is irregular and depends on the West Kameng farmer rotation, not a daily fixture. Lunch service slows when tour-bus arrivals stack at 1pm.
signature_address: Near Y Himalaya Holidays, Main Bazar Line, Bomdila, West Kameng, Arunachal Pradesh 790001

name: Cafe Lungta
why_it_matters: Small highway-side cafe on the Bomdila-Tawang stretch — one of the few places in town doing proper coffee + all-day breakfast for travellers crossing Sela Pass. Listed on TripAdvisor's Bomdila restaurant page; year inferred from the @CafeLungta2016 Facebook handle (verify on visit).
insider_tip: Best as a pit-stop before or after Sela Pass crossing — it's right on the highway. Carry cash; UPI/cards can fail at this altitude when network drops.
signature_address: Tawang Highway, Bomdila, West Kameng, Arunachal Pradesh 790001

name: Pokchi Hotel Restaurant
why_it_matters: Local hotel restaurant listed on TripAdvisor's Bomdila restaurant page (rated 5/5 with limited reviews — small sample). Indian-leaning menu with Tibetan basics; the kind of unflashy local kitchen that survives on residents not tourists.
insider_tip: Tiny operation — call ahead if you're a group of 4+ as kitchen capacity is limited. Reviewer base is thin so quality verify on day of visit.
